text: He wrote down every symptom, examined me all over, asked ever so many questions which I had scarcely strength to answer, and took up his gold-headed cane to depart. My father hung upon every word, but could get nothing from him. He who down examines me scarcely had strength to answer, oncl Ho4 cp hij yo1d~ Leadol cane Io depavl. My father theuh Luy upon every word but could jof nothin fiom hin.
